tasks.en: You've decided to add a pet to your family - but what pet is right? I think that the person who said that a dog is "man's best friend" is absolutely right. In my opinion, dogs make perfect house pets.
tasks.uz: Oilangizga uy hayvoni qo'shishga qaror qildingiz - lekin qaysi uy hayvoni to'g'ri? Menimcha, itni "insonning eng yaxshi do'sti" degan odam mutlaqo haq. Mening fikrimcha, itlar mukammal uy hayvoni.

tasks.en: First of all, dogs make wonderful companions. They always show their happiness as soon as their owner walks through the door, by wagging their tail and jumping up and down excitedly. They are playful and extremely loyal to their owners, so they are good company for the elderly and for children.
tasks.uz: Avvalo, itlar ajoyib hamroh. Egasi eshikdan kirishi bilanoq ular dumini likillatib va hayajon bilan sakrab, xursandchiligini ko'rsatadi. Ular o'ynoqi va egalariga juda sodiq, shuning uchun keksalar va bolalar uchun yaxshi hamroh.

tasks.en: Furthermore, trained dogs are useful to their owners. They are easy to train as watchdogs to guard your house and family, making you feel safe and secure. They can also be trained as guide dogs for the blind. They can be taught all sorts of tricks - even to collect the morning newspaper!
tasks.uz: Bundan tashqari, o'rgatilgan itlar egalariga foydali. Ularni uyingiz va oilangizni qo'riqlash uchun qo'riqchi it sifatida o'rgatish oson - bu sizga xavfsizlik hissini beradi. Ularni ko'zi ojizlar uchun yo'lboshlovchi it sifatida ham o'rgatish mumkin. Ularga har xil fokuslarni o'rgatish mumkin - hatto ertalabki gazetani olib kelishni ham!

tasks.en: On the other hand, dogs need a lot of attention. They need to be fed and brushed, and taken for their daily walk or regular visit to the vet. However, this is a small price to pay in exchange for their friendship and loyalty.
tasks.uz: Boshqa tomondan, itlarga ko'p e'tibor kerak. Ularni boqish, cho'tkalash, har kuni sayrga olib chiqish yoki muntazam veterinarga olib borish kerak. Biroq, bu ularning do'stligi va sodiqligi evaziga to'lanadigan kichik narx.

tasks.en: All in all, although having a dog can be tiring, I believe that they are the best pets. Spending a little time with your dog every day will certainly win you a "best friend" for life.
tasks.uz: Umuman olganda, it saqlash charchatishi mumkin bo'lsa ham, ular eng yaxshi uy hayvoni deb ishonaman. Har kuni itingiz bilan ozgina vaqt o'tkazish sizga umrbod "eng yaxshi do'st"ni albatta beradi.

tasks.en: [C] First of all, it's cruel to take away a wild animal's freedom. Animals such as cats and dogs usually enjoy living with humans, but wild animals don't. They need to live a natural life in their natural habitat, and they need open spaces where they can move freely.
tasks.uz: [C] Avvalo, yovvoyi hayvonning erkinligini tortib olish shafqatsizlik. Mushuk va it kabi hayvonlar odatda odamlar bilan yashashdan zavqlanadi, lekin yovvoyi hayvonlar - yo'q. Ular tabiiy yashash muhitida tabiiy hayot kechirishi kerak va erkin harakatlana oladigan ochiq joylarga muhtoj.

tasks.en: [B] Furthermore, keeping wild animals as pets can be unhealthy for the animals - and dangerous for their owners! Animals kept in a small house or flat cannot get the exercise they need. tasks.uz: [B] Bundan tashqari, yovvoyi hayvonlarni uy hayvoni sifatida saqlash hayvonlar uchun zararli - va egalari uchun xavfli bo'lishi mumkin! tasks.note: ⚠ PARA 3 - 2-DALIL: sog'liq va xavf. Bo'shliq 2 → B ('Furthermore').

exercises.instructionEn: Direct speech is the exact words someone said. We use quotation marks in direct speech: 'I want to help,' Mary said. Reported speech is the exact meaning of what someone said, but not the exact words. We do not use quotation marks. We can either use the word that after the introductory verb or omit it: Mary said (that) she wanted to help. When the introductory verb is in the present tense or when the sentence expresses something which is always true (general truth), there are no changes in the verb tenses: She says 'I love animals.' → She says (that) she loves animals. 'Rhinos live in eastern and southern Africa,' said the teacher. → The teacher said (that) rhinos live in eastern and southern Africa.

Qo'shtirnoq ishlatilmaydi. Kirish fe'lidan keyin 'that' ishlatish yoki tushirib qoldirish mumkin: Meri yordam bermoqchi ekanini aytdi. exercises.instructionEn: When we report statements (a positive or negative sentence), we use the verbs 'say' or 'tell' to introduce the statement. Pronouns (I, you, he, me, you, him, mine, yours) and possessive adjectives (my, your, his) change according to the meaning: Ed said, 'I live in Belfast.' → Ed said (that) he lived in Belfast. When the introductory verb is in the past tense, the verb tenses change: Present Simple → Past Simple ('I want to go out,' he said. → He said he wanted to go out.); Present Continuous → Past Continuous ('She is playing in the garden,' he said. → He said she was playing in the garden.); Present Perfect → Past Perfect ('They have bought a new house,' he said. → He said they had bought a new house.); Past Simple → Past Perfect ('He sent me flowers,' she said. → She said he had sent her flowers.); Future Simple → Conditional (would) ('I'll order a new fridge,' he said. → He said he would order a new fridge.). Certain words and time expressions change: tonight, today, this week → that night, that day, that week; now → then, at the time; yesterday, last night/week → the day before, the previous night/week; tomorrow, next week/month → the following/next day, the next/following week/month; two days ago → two days before; this, these → that, those.

tasks.en: Difference: wh-questions keep the question word; Yes/No questions add 'if'. Both use statement word order and no question mark.

(Zamon o'zgarmaydi - umumiy haqiqat.) 2 'Pingvinlar ucha olmaydi,' dedi u. 3 'Ular hozir televizorda film ko'rishyapti,' dedi u. 4 'Ertaga quyoshli bo'ladi,' deydi u. 5 'Ular o'tgan hafta hayvonot bog'iga borishdi,' dedi u. 6 'Sutemizuvchilar bolalarini sut bilan boqadi,' dedi o'qituvchi. 7 'Biz hech qachon sirkda bo'lmaganmiz,' dedi u. 8 'Men sutni yoqtirmayman,' deydi u. 9 'Ular ertaga xaridga borishadi,' dedi u. 10 'Meri fransuzcha gapirmaydi,' dedi u.

    (he says), 8 (she says)

  3 are watching → were watching;

exercises.instructionEn: When we write an opinion article, we can divide it into five paragraphs.
exercises.instructionUz: Fikr maqolasi yozganda uni besh xatboshiga bo'lishimiz mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
FIKR MAQOLASI TUZILIShI (5
XATBOShI):

  1 - MAVZU + FIKRIMIZ
      (In my opinion, I believe)
      ⚠ Ritorik savol bilan boshlash
      mumkin: 'Why do people think
      that only dogs and cats make
      good pets?'
  2, 3 - NUQTAI NAZARLARIMIZ +
      SABABLAR (firstly, furthermore,
      also)
  4 - QARAMA-QARShI NUQTAI NAZAR +
      SABABLAR (On the other hand,
      However)
  5 - FIKRIMIZNI QAYTA (boshqa
      so'zlar bilan)

  ⚠ ZAMON: hozirgi zamonlar.


⚠ 'A RHETORICAL QUESTION':

  = ritorik savol (javob
  kutilmaydigan).


⚠ 'TO INTRODUCE THE TOPIC':

  = mavzuni kiritmoq.


⚠ 'TO RESTATE':

  = qayta bayon qilmoq.

tasks.en: When we write an opinion article, we can divide it into five paragraphs.
tasks.uz: Fikr maqolasi yozganda uni besh xatboshiga bo'lishimiz mumkin.

tasks.en: In the first paragraph, we introduce the topic and clearly state our opinion. We use: In my opinion, I believe, etc. We can use rhetorical questions to introduce the topic (e.g. Why do people think that only dogs and cats make good pets?).
tasks.uz: Birinchi xatboshida mavzuni kiritamiz va fikrimizni aniq bayon qilamiz. 'In my opinion', 'I believe' va h.k. ni ishlatamiz. Mavzuni kiritish uchun ritorik savollardan foydalanishimiz mumkin (masalan, Nega odamlar faqat it va mushuk yaxshi uy hayvoni deb o'ylaydi?).

tasks.en: In the second and third paragraphs, we give our viewpoints and reasons. We list our viewpoints with firstly, furthermore, also, etc.

tasks.en: In the fourth paragraph, we give the opposing viewpoint and reasons. We can start with: On the other hand, However, etc.

tasks.en:
Why do people think that only dogs and cats make good pets? In my opinion, rabbits make wonderful house pets, too.

First of all, rabbits are friendly animals. They enjoy being with people and they've got interesting personalities. They love playing and they are great fun to watch.

Furthermore, rabbits don't make noise or a mess. They are quiet animals, and it's easy to train them to use a litter tray. They also soon learn not to bite or scratch.

On the other hand, rabbits can cause problems. They like chewing things and digging holes, and they can hurt you if they're scared. However, if you look after them properly, these problems are small.

All in all, I believe that rabbits are perfect pets for people who want a quiet, friendly and amusing companion.

Most people enjoy going to the zoo and looking at the animals - but do the animals enjoy it? I think they are often unhappy and unhealthy. In my opinion, it is completely wrong to keep animals in zoos.

First of all, it's cruel to take away an animal's freedom. Animals in zoos are often kept alone in small cages and they can't move freely. Many of them become so bored and unhappy that they die.

On the other hand, some people say that zoos can help to protect animals. Animals in zoos are safe from hunters, and species which can't survive in the wild can be bred in captivity. However, it would be better to save and protect the animals' natural habitats.

All in all, I believe that animals should not be kept in zoos, because every animal has the right to live freely in its natural environment.

sentencePatterns.formula: Which animal has got [nima]?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Which animal has got two horns? - The rhino.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qaysi hayvon ikkita shoxga ega? - Karkidon.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is/are hunted/killed for their [nima].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Rhinos are hunted for their horns.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Karkidonlar shoxlari uchun ovlanadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is/are facing extinction.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Tigers are facing extinction.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yo'lbarslar yo'qolib ketish xavfiga duch kelmoqda.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is/are in danger of becoming extinct.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Rhinos are in danger of becoming extinct.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Karkidonlar yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostida.

sentencePatterns.formula: X should be + V3 + in captivity.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Rhinos should be bred in captivity.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Karkidonlar asirlikda ko'paytirilishi kerak.

sentencePatterns.formula: In my opinion, people should + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: In my opinion, people should only buy parrots bred in captivity.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mening fikrimcha, odamlar faqat asirlikda ko'paytirilgan to'tiqushlarni sotib olishi kerak.

sentencePatterns.formula: If people stopped + -ING, X would + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If people stopped eating turtle soup, the turtles would survive.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar odamlar toshbaqa sho'rvasini yeyishni to'xtatsa, toshbaqalar omon qolardi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X said (that) + GAP (bir zamon orqaga).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: "I'm tired," he said. → He said (that) he was tired.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: "Charchadim", - dedi u. → U charchaganini aytdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X told + KIM + (that) + GAP.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Ann told us (that) it was getting colder.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ann bizga sovuq tushayotganini aytdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X said to + KIM + (that) + GAP.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He said to me (that) it was raining.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U menga yomg'ir yog'ayotganini aytdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X says (that) + GAP (zamon o'zgarmaydi).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She says (that) she wants to help.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U yordam bermoqchi ekanini aytadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X asked (me) + WH- + EGA + FE'L (o'tgan).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She asked me where I lived.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U mendan qayerda yashashimni so'radi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X asked (me) if + EGA + FE'L (o'tgan).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She asked me if I had a pet.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U mendan uy hayvonim bor-yo'qligini so'radi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X said (that) + FAKT (hozirgi zamon).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He said that hedgehogs sleep during the winter.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U tipratikanlar qishda uxlashini aytdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I'll meet you at the [joy] at [vaqt].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'll meet you at the entrance at six.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Seni soat oltida kirishda kutaman.

sentencePatterns.formula: I (don't) think + GAP.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I don't think dogs are shy animals.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menimcha, itlar uyatchan hayvonlar emas.

sentencePatterns.formula: First of all, ... Furthermore, ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: First of all, dogs are loyal. Furthermore, they are useful.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + asked + (KIMDAN) + if/whether + EGA + O'TGAN ZAMON
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Eve asked if I had bought any bread. They asked her if she was OK.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Iv non sotib olgan-olmaganimni so'radi. Ular undan yaxshimi-yo'qligini so'rashdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + wanted to know + SAVOL SO'ZI / if + EGA + FE'L
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He wanted to know what time the party would begin.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U ziyofat soat nechada boshlanishini bilmoqchi bo'ldi.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + told + KIMGA + that ... / KIM + said + that ... (olmoshsiz)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Brian told me that he liked jazz music. Mother told us that she would be late.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Brayan menga jaz musiqasini yoqtirishini aytdi. Onam bizga kech qolishini aytdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + asked + KIMDAN + whether / where + EGA + FE'L
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They asked Tom whether he wanted any help. Marie asked him where the supermarket was.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular Tomdan yordam kerak-kerakmasligini so'rashdi. Mari undan supermarket qayerdaligini so'radi.

sentencePatterns.formula: If + EGA + O'TGAN ZAMON, EGA + would + FE'L
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If I had a garden, I would plant some roses.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bog'im bo'lganida, atirgullar ekardim.

sentencePatterns.formula: When/If + EGA + HOZIRGI, EGA + HOZIRGI / will + FE'L
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When you put coins in this machine, it gives you a ticket. If you aren't careful, you will cut yourself.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu mashinaga tanga solsangiz, chipta beradi. Ehtiyot bo'lmasangiz, o'zingizni kesib olasiz.

sentencePatterns.formula: too + SIFAT + for KIM + to + FE'L
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Mexican food is too spicy for me to eat.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Meksika taomi men uchun yeyishga juda achchiq.

sentencePatterns.formula: By the time + O'TGAN, EGA + were / had + V3
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: By the time I arrived home the children were fast asleep.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men uyga kelgunimcha bolalar qattiq uxlab qolgan edi.

sentencePatterns.formula: A/An + HAYVON has got + A'ZOLAR. It can + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: A cheetah has got spots and a long tail. It can run very fast.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Gepardning dog'lari va uzun dumi bor. U juda tez yugura oladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is a bird, but it can't fly.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: An emu is a bird, but it can't fly.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Emu qush, lekin ucha olmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is in danger of becoming extinct.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: These animals are now in danger of becoming extinct.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu hayvonlar endi yo'qolib ketish xavfida.

sentencePatterns.formula: X needs to be protected from Y.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Rhinos need to be protected from hunters.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Karkidonlarni ovchilardan himoya qilish kerak.

sentencePatterns.formula: X said (that) + GAP (zamon bir qadam orqaga).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: 'I love horses.' → She said that she loved horses.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 'Otlarni yaxshi ko'raman.' → U otlarni yaxshi ko'rishini aytdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X told + KIShI + (that) + GAP.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: My parents told me that I could have a dog.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ota-onam menga it olishim mumkinligini aytishdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X asked + KIShI + if + GAP TARTIBI.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The waitress asked them if they were ready to order.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ofitsiant qiz ulardan buyurtma berishga tayyormi deb so'radi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X asked + KIShI + WH-so'z + GAP TARTIBI.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Jill asked the shop assistant how much the skirt cost.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jill sotuvchidan yubka qancha turishini so'radi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X asked + KIShI + wh-so'z + EGA + FE'L (gap tartibi).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He asked me what the time was.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U mendan soat nechaligini so'radi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X told + KIShI + (that) + GAP. / X said (to KIShI) + (that) + GAP.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She told us that she had never seen a python.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U bizga hech qachon piton ko'rmaganini aytdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: GAP, although / but / because / so / and + GAP.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Rabbits are friendly animals, but they can hurt you if they're scared.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Quyonlar do'stona hayvonlar, lekin qo'rqsalar sizni shikastlashi mumkin.

sentencePatterns.formula: What are you doing this weekend? - I haven't made any plans yet. What about you?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What are you doing this weekend? - I haven't made any plans yet. What about you?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu dam olish kuni nima qilyapsan? - Hali reja tuzmadim. Senchi?

sentencePatterns.formula: In my opinion, it is completely wrong to + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: In my opinion, it is completely wrong to keep animals in zoos.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mening fikrimcha, hayvonlarni hayvonot bog'ida saqlash mutlaqo noto'g'ri.

sentencePatterns.formula: First of all, ... Furthermore, ... Also, ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: First of all, it's cruel to take away an animal's freedom. Furthermore, zoos can be unhealthy.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Avvalo, erkinlikni tortib olish shafqatsizlik. Bundan tashqari, hayvonot bog'lari zararli bo'lishi mumkin.

sentencePatterns.formula: On the other hand, some people say that ... However, ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: On the other hand, some people say that zoos protect animals. However, it would be better to protect their habitats.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Boshqa tomondan, ba'zilar hayvonot bog'lari hayvonlarni himoya qiladi deyishadi. Ammo yashash muhitini himoya qilish yaxshiroq bo'lardi.

sentencePatterns.formula: All in all, I believe that ..., because ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: All in all, I believe that animals should not be kept in zoos, because every animal has the right to live freely.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Umuman olganda, hayvonlarni hayvonot bog'ida saqlamaslik kerak deb hisoblayman, chunki har bir hayvon erkin yashash huquqiga ega.
